detail.longDescription: "The study was among broader research into why Black Americans are twice as likely as their white peers to develop Alzheimer’s, but the Trump administration abruptly halted it in its final stretch. Researchers say the move not only wasted more than $8 million in taxpayer money already spent but also is a blow to the hard-earned trust of anxious study participants who won’t even learn if their brain tests showed signs of trouble." https:// apnews.com/article/nih-medical -grants-science-diversity-equity-56109da4a1f4d112d6f266b0f8df1b6f # dementia # research # NIH # BlackMastodon
